prose: Short note from feed metadata only: Forbes (Tim Keary) reports that Hex Technologies, the data analytics provider, has raised a $100 million Series D led by Peak XV at a $1.2 billion valuation, on the claim that it rebuilt its platform for AI agents - the piece frames it as a company that 'threw out its code' to stop the 'SaaSpocalypse.' The source is error-cached, so the details of the rebuild and the numbers behind the claim are unverified here.
highlights: Hex Technologies raises a $100M Series D led by Peak XV at a $1.2B valuation
Pitch: the analytics platform rebuilt for AI agents - 'threw out its code' against the SaaSpocalypse
